title: PAUL_DPO_Preference_Pair
description: Schema for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) preference pairs in PAUL Open Model Phase 3.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DPO preference pair.

track.description: Behavioral adaptation track targeted by this preference pair.

domain.description: Subject domain (e.g. physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, education).

prompt.description: User query or multi-turn prompt context.

chosen.description: Preferred assistant completion demonstrating target behavior.

rejected.description: Dispreferred completion exhibiting anti-pattern (e.g. lecture dump, preamble verbosity, meta-talk).

rejection_reason.description: Primary behavioral failure category demonstrated by the rejected response.

human_verified.description: Whether this preference pair has received human expert sign-off.

benchmark_leakage_checked.description: Whether this pair has passed automated benchmark leakage checks.

review_notes.description: Notes from human reviewer explaining the preference distinction.

review_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of human review.

approved.description: Final approval boolean for training inclusion.
